name: Ajwa for Food Industries Co.
source: stockanalysis.com (secondary data provider, figures as reported by that provider, not read from the exchange filing) | EGXBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: the EGX Listing Committee decision of 20 October 2026 imposed an EGP 40,000 penalty on the company for failing to provide the CONSOLIDATED financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, and the standalone and consolidated statements for the periods ended 31 March 2026 and 30 June 2026 (disclosure mirrored at https://foudalens.com/en/news/296390, original on egx.com.eg NewsID 296390). Standalone FY2025 results were filed on 30 June 2026 and the disclosure summary gives net profit EGP 2,798,788 against EGP 7,843,797 for FY2024 and revenue EGP 452,757,000 against EGP 304,131,000. Those are STANDALONE figures while this file holds the consolidated series (stockanalysis.com), so they are not appended as a period. The filed documents are image-only scans: the results release and the board report both extract 0 characters and OCR recovers only the letterhead, so no consolidated line can be transcribed until the company files. | CRON 2026-11-28: FY2025 column added. Figures printed by two independent providers, not derived except where tagged. Revenue, Gross Profit and the Cost of Sales difference are from the Reuters LSEG annual income statement (millions EGP, converted to absolute EGP); Net Profit is the audited figure published in the company's own Egyptian Exchange results disclosure. Rows not printed by any reachable free source (Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT), Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, EPS) are left empty rather than estimated; the free EGX summaries publish only the top and bottom line. The stored earlier years reproduce the same provider exactly on the overlapping year, which is why these rows are on the same basis. Carrier of the FY2025 figures: the consolidated EGX results disclosure for the year ended 31 December 2025 reports a net loss of 89,629,971 EGP including minority interests (the same filing gives 10,603,881 EGP for FY2024, which is the total basis the stored FY2024 net profit of 10,880,000 follows). Arab Finance, reporting the same filing, gives consolidated revenues of 1,976 million EGP for FY2025 against 1,702 million for FY2024, and the stored FY2024 revenue is 1,702,000,000 exactly. Consolidated revenue and consolidated net loss are stored; gross profit is not published by any reachable free source for this year, and the attributable loss of 78,968,000 EGP is not used because the stored series is on the total basis.
note: Figures in the unit shown, converted from the provider's millions EGP. Each fiscal year header cell was matched to its own data cell, so the provider trailing twelve month column is excluded. Every printed identity ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Net profit for periods carrying a minority interest is the profit for the year before that interest, which the provider prints as earnings from continuing operations.
verified_note: Gap record written 17 Nov 2026. No figure was changed, added or removed in this step.
